risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Management flags volatility in interest rates and financing costs, and interest rate fluctuations, as a threat and a risk under RISKS AND CONCERNS.
- Real estate projects depend on timely regulatory approvals; delays in obtaining statutory approvals and regulatory clearances are explicitly flagged as both a threat and a major risk.
- The Company flags an increase in construction material and labour costs, and escalation in construction and labour costs, as a threat and major risk that could pressure execution economics.
- Risks relating to project execution and timely completion are explicitly identified as a major risk in the MD&A Risks and Concerns section.
- The Company is exposed to intense competition from established and emerging real estate developers, which could affect market position and pricing.
- Liquidity management and availability of funds is listed as a major risk under the Board's risk management framework.
- Economic uncertainties, adverse market conditions and an economic slowdown affecting consumer demand and market sentiment are flagged as threats and risks; fluctuations in customer demand and changing market dynamics are separately identified as a major risk.
- Shortage or limited availability of skilled manpower is listed as a threat facing the Company.
